clue.text: Swears at adult leaving public transport

explanation.surface: Someone shouts insults at a grown-up getting off a bus or train.
explanation.definitionFit: Buses are large road vehicles carrying paying passengers, the commonest form of public transport.

clue.text: Victor entering only possible answer

parts.note: sole means the only one

clue.text: Marks smeared in glass

explanation.surface: Smudges are smeared on a glass.
explanation.definitionFit: Signals are signs or indications, as are marks used to show something.

clue.text: Amazing bird concealing tail in nest

parts.note: its last letter

ants are insects

clue.text: Adult allowed in these short runners

parts.note: A is the film-rating abbreviation for adult

a short word loses its final letter

parts.note: the word as written

clue.text: Large pet damaged hotel cable

parts.note: H is Hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet

clue.text: Bug? Some believe epidemic's over

clue.text: Graceful European student, for example, with a set of books

clue.text: Former lover mentioned getting aroused

something cited has been mentioned or referred to

clue.text: Woods set to lose heart after shout from golfer

clue.text: King with ecstasy put on suits creating responses

clue.text: Shocks almost guaranteed power increases

indicators.note: almost means not quite all, so the last letter goes

parts.note: sure means guaranteed
P is the physics abbreviation for power
rises means increases

explanation.surface: Power costs increase nearly for sure.
explanation.definitionFit: Surprises, as a verb, means startles or shocks.

clue.text: Grab dividends from the bank

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to grab someone's attention
second meaning: the money a bank pays on savings

explanation.definitionFit: Interest is both a verb for capturing attention and the noun for money earned on deposits.

clue.text: Finding out leader's changed? Fancy!

parts.note: learning is finding things out

clue.text: Everyone ate stolen sandwiches — most smart

indicators.note: to sandwich is to enclose, so the answer is held within these words

explanation.surface: Everybody ate the stolen sandwiches, the cleverest trick.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sandwiches' looks like food the thieves ate, but it is a verb.

clue.text: Screw — one left over found within wide-mouthed vessel

indicators.note: these pieces are placed inside the vessel

parts.note: a jar is a container with a wide mouth
I is the Roman numeral one
O is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for an over

clue.text: Lay a rug on street in France that has to be taken up

indicators.note: in a down clue the first pieces sit on top of the next

parts.note: a mat is a small rug

indicators.text: that has to be taken up

parts.note: rue is French for street

explanation.walkthrough: 'Lay' is not to put down but the adjective meaning non-professional.

clue.text: Go to a bike race on purpose

parts.note: TT is the Tourist Trophy motorcycle race on the Isle of Man

clue.text: Animal shelter with dog inside house

parts.note: a cote is a shelter for doves or sheep

clue.text: Train carriage

definitions.meaning: second meaning: a horse-drawn carriage or a railway carriage

clue.text: Farmer may drive this rubbish wagon in reverse

indicators.note: the whole string is read backwards

parts.note: rot means nonsense, rubbish
a cart is a wagon

clue.text: Hardy character keeping fit ultimately for trials

indicators.note: the name holds the other letter within it

parts.note: Tess of the d'Urbervilles is Thomas Hardy's heroine

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the word

parts.note: its last letter

clue.text: Love a party with Royal Engineers

parts.note: a do is a party
RE is the abbreviation for the British Army's Royal Engineers

clue.text: Refreshment break — work even less after little energy

explanation.definitionFit: Elevenses is a British mid-morning snack, a tea or coffee pause taken around eleven o'clock.

clue.text: Paused hospital diets and ate nuts

parts.note: H is the map abbreviation for hospital

clue.text: Grows flowers, but not the first one

parts.note: irises are flowers

explanation.surface: A garden grows flowers, all but the first of them.
